Also: https://www.scotsman.com/news/politics/andy-burnham-promises-to-devolve-more-power-in-pitch-to-scotland-8767514
(Search snippet content)

Burnham has said his government will transfer more power to Wales and Scotland, offering "new opportunities to extend devolution in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland by taking powers deeper down", arguing that people in places like Dundee and Bangor feel just as distant from Holyrood and the Senedd as they do from Westminster.

Criticism:
- SNP leader John Swinney criticised Burnham's suggestion that regions of Scotland feel equally distant from Holyrood as from Westminster, dismissing Burnham's "lack of knowledge" about Scotland.
- Wales Online declined to publish an opinion piece attributed to Burnham because "it was confused about where power and responsibility lies in Wales".
- May 2026 Senedd elections saw a direct transfer of 40% of Labour voters from the previous elections to Plaid Cymru, largely over concerns about Labour's approach to Welsh devolution.
